correctness.rationale: All four conic components are smooth. The source-listed points exhaust pairwise component intersections by the exact local incidence/contact calculation and Bézout accounting; the affine Jacobian ideals independently have support p1,p2,p3 in the x0=1 chart and p4,p5 in the x2=1 chart. The A3 and D4 identifications follow from the branch tangencies. At p4 and p5, five smooth branches have two contact-two pairs and eight transverse pairs, giving delta=12 and mu=20. Exact localization of the Tjurina ideal at p4 has leading monomials t,u^4,u^3v,u^2v^3,uv^6,v^8, hence dimension 18; symmetry gives the same at p5. Two second blow-ups after the initial multiplicity-five blow-up give exceptional multiplicities 7 and 7, and A'Campo's formula yields the stated degree-20 monodromy polynomial. The included verifier replays the exact algebra.
